original_test_intent: Verify BMC reachability through shared and dedicated LAN across all three required physical cable states without a surviving path masking failure.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Operator applies each exact cable state; agent validates path-specific identity/reachability.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Expected shared/dedicated behavior is correct in every state.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED MANUAL ONLY to hybrid REQUIRES.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator moves/verifies cables; path-specific checks automate.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: All three cable states and both management paths.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Port/topology map, simultaneous behavior and isolated network/recovery.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Cached session or alternate live path is not proof of port under test.

original_method: Physical cable transitions plus reachability checks.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind probes to source interface/path and correlate BMC identity for each operator-confirmed state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cable change can remove management access.

no_automatic_retry: Unexpected loss stops; no extra cable/network changes.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 correctly classifies manual preparation plus automated core checks as hybrid.
